eligibility.quote: The publisher (franka_state_controller from franka_ros, run in franka_control) and the reporter's own subscriber node /MoveRobot ("No this Node is my own, because i need some data from the robot for my application.") are separate units interacting through the topic /franka_state_controller/franka_states of type franka_msgs/FrankaState. The two sides carry different franka_msgs/FrankaState definitions (md5 ed28b9cb... vs 7782ef1d...). The resolving change is a CMakeLists.txt find_package edit, but its effect is to rebuild the consumer against the provider's changed definition, which the tree counts as an interface change, not build-only.
